name: Microsoft Azure
tagline: Microsoft's enterprise cloud: infrastructure, OpenAI-powered Foundry and hybrid, sold with Microsoft 365
facts: Satya Nadella CEO; Scott Guthrie, Cloud + AI

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: The AI platform for the enterprise: one cloud from silicon to Copilot agents, trusted and compliant.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Bundle Azure with Microsoft 365, Windows Server, SQL licences and Copilot; win via enterprise agreements.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Deepest enterprise relationships, hybrid heritage, Entra identity, and privileged OpenAI IP rights.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Microsoft Foundry multi-model agent platform plus Fairwater AI datacentres and Maia chips to cut OpenAI dependence.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: OpenAI exclusivity ended Apr 2026 yet Azure accelerated: was OpenAI the moat, or the distribution?

customers.pain: Migrating legacy Windows, SQL, SAP workloads securely
customers.why: Licence portability (Hybrid Benefit), single contract, existing Microsoft trust

customers.who: Enterprise dev teams, ISVs building agents
customers.pain: Need frontier models with enterprise security and compliance
customers.why: Foundry: OpenAI GPT-5.x first, plus Claude, Llama, Mistral, under Entra controls

customers.who: OpenAI, other model labs needing compute
customers.pain: Massive training and inference capacity at short notice
customers.why: Fairwater supercomputer sites, Nvidia GB300 scale, long-term partnership

customers.pain: Data residency and sovereign control requirements
customers.why: Sovereign cloud offerings, Azure Local, four in-country regions in India

customers.pain: Need a channel into enterprise IT budgets
customers.why: Huge partner program; Marketplace purchases count against Azure commits

products.name: Azure Virtual Machines
products.desc: Compute incl. Nvidia GPU and Cobalt Arm instances

products.name: Azure Arc / Azure Local
products.desc: Manage on-prem and multicloud from Azure

products.name: Azure SQL / Cosmos DB
products.desc: Managed relational and global NoSQL databases

portfolio.north_star: Consumed Azure revenue from production workloads under enterprise agreements
portfolio.key_metrics: Azure growth %, consumption vs commit, migration wins, capacity online
portfolio.guardrails: Outage frequency, capacity shortfalls, licence-change backlash

products.name: Microsoft Foundry
products.desc: Models, Agent Service, Foundry IQ; renamed at Build 2026

products.name: Azure OpenAI models
products.desc: GPT-5.5/5.6 with enterprise security and data residency

products.name: Maia / Cobalt chips
products.desc: In-house AI accelerator and Arm CPU

products.name: GitHub Copilot
products.desc: AI coding agent driving Azure developer pull-through

portfolio.north_star: Enterprise agents in production on Foundry each week
portfolio.key_metrics: Tokens served, Foundry customers, AI revenue contribution to Azure points
portfolio.guardrails: Responsible-AI incidents, inference gross margin, OpenAI dependence share

products.name: Microsoft Fabric
products.desc: Unified analytics and data lake SaaS

products.name: Entra ID
products.desc: Identity and access, the enterprise control plane

portfolio.north_star: Organisations running data and security estates on Microsoft
portfolio.key_metrics: Fabric paid customers, Sentinel ingestion, cross-sell to Azure

rows.who_pays: Enterprises via enterprise agreements and MACC commits
rows.how: Pay-as-you-go or prepaid commits with discounts
Per token, provisioned throughput units, agent runtime
Reserved capacity; major share of $678B RPO growth
Windows Server, SQL Server licences and subscriptions

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Intelligent Cloud ~$39B/qtr: Azure plus server products, GitHub, Nuance; Azure is the growth engine.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Developers use; CIOs sign enterprise agreements; OpenAI is a mega-customer inflating backlog.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: AI infra lowers cloud gross margin; FY27 guide op margin down under a point; capex ~$175B.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Convert RPO (~30% in 12 months), Foundry agents, capacity adds, Microsoft 365 Copilot pull-through.

bullets.label: Disclosure
bullets.text: Microsoft reports Azure only as growth %; FY26 crossed $100B annual revenue for first time.

friction: Capacity shortages delay customers' AI deployments
Portal and service naming change often, confusing users
Licensing rules seen as locking in Microsoft customers
Costs hard to predict across consumption and commits

competitors.label: AI platforms
competitors.text: Amazon Bedrock (now with OpenAI), Google Vertex, Anthropic direct

competitors.label: India
competitors.text: AWS, Google Cloud, Yotta, Jio-led and sovereign clouds

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Enterprise distribution and bundling with Microsoft 365, Entra and GitHub

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: OpenAI multicloud shift, capacity shortfalls, regulatory scrutiny of bundling

news.text: Q4 FY26: Azure +43%, Intelligent Cloud $39.3B, RPO $678B

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: OpenAI deal amended; Azure no longer exclusive third-party cloud for OpenAI

news.label: Watch
news.text: Q1 FY27 Azure growth, capacity adds, OpenAI share of backlog

sources: Microsoft FY26 Q3-Q4 results, Synergy Research Q2 2026, Microsoft India announcements, press coverage. North star/metrics are PM judgement for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
